<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=42239 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=implemented_on_main confidence=high -->
This is implemented on current `main`; thanks for the clear Desktop-specific report.

Automated hermes-sweeper review evidence:
- `b94b3622b5faabadf36d8d51f5804c0a655553e7` added the Desktop profile rail, per-profile gateway switching, cross-profile sessions, and profile-scoped config/model routing. It shipped in `v2026.6.5`.
- `apps/desktop/src/app/chat/sidebar/profile-switcher.tsx:278` renders selectable named profile controls; `apps/desktop/src/store/profile.ts:298` switches the live gateway and starts a fresh profile-scoped session.
- `apps/desktop/src/app/session/hooks/use-session-list-actions.ts:171` scopes sidebar session retrieval to the active profile; `apps/desktop/src/app/settings/config-settings.tsx:269` and `apps/desktop/src/app/settings/model-settings.tsx:251` refresh profile-specific configuration and model state.
- The linked #38357 discussion was later closed as implemented, including the related unified All profiles session view.
